description.en: shadcn UI components re-engineered for emotion and styled-components setups.
description.zh: 将 shadcn/ui 组件解构并适配为 CSS-in-JS（Emotion / Styled）架构的实现。

content.en: shadcn-cssinjs addresses enterprise codebases that rely on Emotion or styled-components rather than Tailwind CSS. It ports shadcn/ui's beloved Radix-backed components and clean design language to traditional CSS-in-JS paradigms without sacrificing component quality.
content.zh: shadcn-cssinjs 专为采用 Emotion 或 styled-components 技术栈的企业级前端工程打造。它将 shadcn/ui 标志性的高品质 Radix 组件设计与交互逻辑完整移植到 CSS-in-JS 环境中，让不使用 Tailwind 的团队同样能够享受到 shadcn 体系的便利。
